The '''Mos Ila Market''' was a market operating in the center of [[Mos Ila]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and in the years that followed.<ref name="TOR" />
